components.name: TopOpt Case Result
components.description: Select a completed load-case response without rerunning the solver. Uses the saved job folder; keep it in place.

outputs.name: Case result
outputs.description: Connect to the matching Results component

components.name: TopOpt Engineering
components.description: Units, independent load cases, convergence and final-shape voxel verification. Read Report for case results and limitations.

inputs.name: Source result
inputs.description: Mode 2 only: completed engineering optimization with unchanged inputs

inputs.name: Design limits
inputs.description: Optional Design Limits component; applies to every case

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Use Results 3D, or 2D FEM Results / Results matching Mode. Use Case Result to select a case after completion

outputs.name: Job folder
outputs.description: Project, case files, history and report.html

components.name: TopOpt Engineering Settings
components.description: Solver, convergence and manufacturing controls. Minimum feature is diagnostic only; symmetry/extrusion are enforced.

inputs.name: Backend
inputs.description: 0 CPU direct; 1 CPU CG; 2 CPU AMG; 3 CPU matrix-free; 4 CUDA CG

inputs.name: CPU threads
inputs.description: BLAS thread limit; not a guarantee all solver stages run in parallel

inputs.name: Manufacturing process
inputs.description: 0 unspecified; 1 machining; 2 injection molding; 3 additive. Process checks are advisory

inputs.name: Symmetry axis
inputs.description: 0 none; 1 X; 2 Y; 3 Z. Domain and Keep must be symmetric

inputs.name: Minimum feature
inputs.description: Requested length; voxel erosion diagnostic, not an enforced thickness constraint

inputs.name: Keep attachments
inputs.description: Preserve active cells touching support and point-load nodes. Surface-load cells are always preserved

inputs.name: RAM budget GiB
inputs.description: 3D only: 0 uses 60% of currently free RAM. Positive value is a lower budget. Leave 0 for 2D.

inputs.name: Physical filter radius
inputs.description: Model length units; 0 uses Radius in cells. Keep this length fixed when comparing grid refinements.

components.name: TopOpt Gravity
components.description: Self-weight from Material density. Acceleration always in m/s^2, independent of model units. Connect to the same Load Case as other simultaneous loads.

inputs.name: Acceleration
inputs.description: World acceleration in m/s^2; for XY 2D use (0,-9.80665,0)

outputs.name: Load
outputs.description: Connect to Load Case, then Engineering

components.name: TopOpt Load Case
components.description: Forces inside one case act simultaneously. Different cases are solved independently with a weighted compliance objective.

inputs.name: Loads
inputs.description: Point loads, Surface Load or Gravity outputs

components.name: TopOpt Material
components.description: Sourced elastic reference presets with explicit units. Read Info for provenance and limitations.

inputs.name: Preset
inputs.description: 0: structural steel; 1: injection-molded ABS GP-22 reference

inputs.name: Length unit
inputs.description: 0: mm; 1: m. Must match geometry coordinates

inputs.name: Safety factor
inputs.description: Screening only, not automatic code verification

inputs.name: Stock thickness mm
inputs.description: S235 reference yield only enabled for declared stock thickness >0 and <=16 mm

inputs.name: Poisson override
inputs.description: -1 uses preset. ABS default 0.35 is an assumption

components.name: TopOpt Review Controls
components.description: Show one stage at a time. Route Case and Field to the case selectors and result viewers.

inputs.name: Visible stage
inputs.description: 0 baseline FEM; 1 optimization; 2 voxel verification; 3 extracted geometry; 4 final TET4 FEM

inputs.name: Field
inputs.description: 0 default (FEM stress / design density); 1 displacement; 2 stress (relaxed during design)

outputs.name: Show surface
outputs.description: Connect to Final Geometry Results Preview

outputs.name: Show final FEM
outputs.description: Connect to Final FEM Results Preview

components.name: TopOpt Domain
components.description: Planar domain discretized by cell centers. Preview is the actual solver grid.

inputs.name: Keep
inputs.description: Closed regions kept at full density; counted in Volume

inputs.name: Cell size
inputs.description: Square cell edge in model units

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.description: Design plane; also defines support X/Y

components.name: TopOpt Load
components.description: TOTAL vector force shared equally among unique selected nodes. All loads act simultaneously.

inputs.name: Total force
inputs.description: World vector, in plane. Total force for this component

outputs.name: Load
outputs.description: Connect one or more loads to Solver

outputs.name: Directions
outputs.description: Direction glyphs, one cell long; force magnitude is the input F

components.name: TopOpt Support
components.description: Select points/curves and constrained local directions. Points show snapped FEM nodes.

outputs.name: Support
outputs.description: Connect one or more supports to Solver

components.name: TopOpt Results
components.description: Density and thresholded planar mesh. Threshold geometry has not been structurally reanalysed. Bake explicitly adds the threshold mesh to Rhino.

inputs.name: Deformation scale
inputs.description: Visual scale only, does not alter calculation

inputs.name: Bake
inputs.description: Button pulse: add the current threshold mesh to Rhino

inputs.name: Show preview
inputs.description: Turn this stage preview and legend on/off

outputs.name: Density
outputs.description: Undeformed mesh colored by selected Field; default density

outputs.name: Metrics
outputs.description: Metrics for exactly the displayed density

components.name: TopOpt FEM Results
components.description: Full-solid FEM: stress, displacement and reactions. Stress components use domain axes; vectors use world axes. See Info for units and color range.

inputs.name: Field
inputs.description: 0 or 2 = von Mises stress; 1 = displacement magnitude

inputs.name: Deformation scale
inputs.description: Preview only: 0 = original shape; 1 = actual displacements

inputs.name: Legend maximum
inputs.description: 0 auto; positive fixes the field scale

inputs.name: Show preview
inputs.description: Turn this stage preview and legend on/off

outputs.name: Von Mises
outputs.description: Maximum of four Gauss-point values per cell; force/length^2

outputs.name: Sigma X
outputs.description: Mean Gauss-point sigma_x per cell, DOMAIN axes; force/length^2

outputs.name: Sigma Y
outputs.description: Mean Gauss-point sigma_y per cell, DOMAIN axes; force/length^2

outputs.name: Tau XY
outputs.description: Mean Gauss-point shear per cell, DOMAIN axes; force/length^2

outputs.name: Nodes
outputs.description: World nodes in the same order as U and reactions

outputs.name: Displacements
outputs.description: Actual WORLD displacement vectors, length units, aligned to P

outputs.name: Reactions
outputs.description: WORLD support reactions, force units, aligned to P; zero on free DOFs

outputs.name: Info
outputs.description: Color legend, material, extrema and limitations

components.name: TopOpt Compare Results
components.description: Compare every load case and mass against a matching full-solid baseline. Relaxed optimization stress is not compared with final-shape stress.

components.name: TopOpt Design Limits
components.description: Displacement and stress limits for all independent load cases. FEM checks full material; optimization uses explicitly labelled relaxed stress constraints.

inputs.name: Maximum displacement
inputs.description: Model length units (Material mm or m). 0 disables

inputs.name: Maximum stress MPa
inputs.description: Explicit von Mises limit in MPa, independent of model units. 0 disables

inputs.name: Use material allowable
inputs.description: Use Material allowable instead of explicit stress. Requires available material/stock data

inputs.name: Enforce in optimization
inputs.description: True uses MMA and adjoint constraints; False reports checks only

inputs.name: Constraint tolerance
inputs.description: Normalized numerical tolerance; .001 = 0.1%. Exceedance within this band is labelled explicitly

components.name: TopOpt Example Geometry
components.description: Built-in 12 x 6 plate with a circular hole and preserved end strips. Disconnect its wires to reference your own CAD geometry.

components.name: TopOpt Scenario Geometry
components.description: 0 Cantilever; 1 Supported beam; 2 Two holes; 3 Two loads. Teaching geometry in XY.

components.name: TopOpt Surface Load
components.description: Uniform pressure or vector traction integrated on grid boundary facets. Positive pressure acts inward. Loaded cells are automatically preserved by Engineering optimization.

inputs.name: Patch selection

inputs.name: Pressure
inputs.description: Force/length squared in Material units; positive inward, negative outward

inputs.name: Traction
inputs.description: World vector in force/length squared, used in Mode 1

inputs.name: Boundary side
inputs.description: 0 all exposed faces; 1 +X; 2 -X; 3 +Y; 4 -Y; 5 +Z; 6 -Z. 2D uses domain axes

inputs.name: Selection tolerance
inputs.description: Distance from facet center to selection, as fraction of h. Geometry selection is optional

outputs.name: Loaded facets
outputs.description: Actual discretized loading boundary; verify selection

outputs.name: Directions
outputs.description: Load directions; display length is one cell, not force magnitude

components.name: TopOpt Results 3D
components.description: FEM stress or optimization density. Cut removes voxels from preview only. Bake exports unsmoothed threshold boundary; only completed optimization with Cut axis=0.

inputs.name: Threshold
inputs.description: Optimization shape only; FEM ignores this

inputs.name: Field
inputs.description: 0: FEM von Mises / optimization density; 1: displacement magnitude; 2: stress (relaxed during optimization)

inputs.name: Cut fraction
inputs.description: Keep centers below this fraction of axis extent

inputs.name: Bake
inputs.description: Completed optimization; Cut must be zero. Bake full threshold mesh, undeformed.

inputs.name: Legend maximum
inputs.description: 0 auto; positive fixes the scale for displacement/stress

inputs.name: Show preview
inputs.description: Turn this stage preview and legend on/off

outputs.name: Shape
outputs.description: Full undeformed threshold boundary; not reanalysed

outputs.name: Reactions
outputs.description: FEM only: world reactions aligned to P

outputs.name: Von Mises
outputs.description: FEM only: max of 8 Gauss points per voxel, force/length^2

components.name: TopOpt Final FEM 3D
components.description: Remesh an extracted surface with Gmsh and solve independent load cases using TET4. Optional three-level mesh study. Surface support patches required.

inputs.name: Mesh size
inputs.description: Independent tetrahedral mesh target size; 0 uses original voxel size

inputs.name: Mesh levels
inputs.description: 1 FEM only; 2/3 refinement levels, each size x0.75

inputs.name: Design limits
inputs.description: Optional new checking limits; otherwise use source project limits

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Completed surface or final FEM result

outputs.name: Files
outputs.description: Surface STL path or FEM job folder

components.name: TopOpt Final Geometry 3D
components.description: Extract a closed density surface preserving protected regions. Optional shelf CAD contract restores nominal plates and clearances. Geometry is not yet reanalysed.

inputs.name: Smoothing
inputs.description: Gaussian density smoothing in cells; 0 disables; Keep is reinserted exactly

inputs.name: Edited mesh
inputs.description: Optional closed triangulatable mesh in world coordinates; checked against original Keep/envelope

inputs.name: Nominal CAD specification
inputs.description: Optional Shelf Bracket specification. Restores nominal plates/holes to chord tolerance; requires matching CAD loads.

inputs.name: Nominal CAD loads
inputs.description: Matching Bracket Cases Summary. Total loads are reapplied to nominal physical regions.

inputs.name: CAD chord tolerance mm
inputs.description: Maximum radial chord error for nominal circular holes in exported triangle surface

inputs.name: Envelope cleanup mm
inputs.description: Shelf CAD only: snap surface vertices to nominal envelope planes within this distance per axis; 0 disables. Actual movement is reported.

inputs.name: Web cleanup mm
inputs.description: Shelf CAD only: bounded simplification of the extracted web before nominal plates/holes are restored; 0 disables. Exported geometry records the cleanup.

outputs.name: Result
outputs.description: Completed surface or final FEM result

outputs.name: Files
outputs.description: Surface STL path or FEM job folder

inputs.name: Field

components.name: TopOpt Print Review
components.description: Additive geometry screening: build direction, overhangs and sampled normal-ray thickness. Does not enforce printability in optimization.

inputs.name: Build direction
inputs.description: World build direction, from plate upward

inputs.name: Overhang angle
inputs.description: Maximum wall overhang from vertical, degrees

inputs.name: Minimum wall
inputs.description: Model length units, sampled normal-ray check; 0 disables limit
